title: List user-filter chips draw the raw field key ("category") until the object definition arrives: UserFilters resolves the label from `objectDef`, which ListView holds at null until `getObjectSchema` answers
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured defect with a named site. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the cloud#2915 dev's measured split (its report on objectstack-ai/cloud#2915; cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2972 fixes cloud's half and adds no override for these). ⛔ Not a claim; no assignee. Grading is triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `packages/plugin-list` (one dev round). **Pull:** objectstack-ai/cloud#2915 item 2 (the maintainer's 2026-10-16 walk, zh-CN): 我的软件包's group selector "reads the raw field name `category` before translations arrive (分类 after)". Measured: it is the object definition it waits for, not the bundle.

**Dedupe:** REST enumeration of this repository's issues updated since 2026-08-15 (735 issues, open and closed; control objectui#12294 found), grepped for `data-list.tsx`, `repeater … Loading`, `elements.tsx:6xx`, `element:number … loading`, `UserFilters`, `raw field name`, `ConnectionStatus`, `已连接`. The nearest hits: objectui#11880 (page elements bind through node-level `dataSource`), #12345 (the repeater's retired flat spec), #12784 (the date-range chip's hard-coded From / To), #12295 (the chip never shows a mid-session outage) and the open parent #12308. None names this.

## What happens (read at `ef71a09f9e5f`)

- Cloud's page (`packages/service-tenant/src/pages/sys-package.page.ts:100-110`) declares `userFilters.fields: [{ field: 'category' }]` with no label; the field's label is `Category` and zh-CN carries `分类`.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2210` sets `objectDef` to `null` until `getObjectSchema` resolves (`:2221`). Meanwhile `packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx:461` reads `objectName = objectDef?.name` (undefined), `:351` `resolvedLabel = f.label ?? objectLabel` (both undefined), and `:679` draws `f.label || f.field` — the raw key.

## Wanted

While the object definition is pending, a user-filter chip whose field carries no authored label draws a placeholder (or nothing), never the machine key; once the definition arrives it draws the field's translated label. Done when a test beside `UserFilters.tsx` renders a chip with a pending definition and asserts no raw key is drawn.

Dedupe words: userFilters raw field name, filter chip field key before schema, UserFilters objectDef null label, dropdown chip category
